title: Seven Palms Reunion
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Seven Palms Reunion”, a luxury 6-bedr, 6 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 36 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your beach getaway now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Resort-Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - New Construction - Short Walk to the Beach Welcome to Seven Palms Reunion, a lavish retreat nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, just a stone’s throw away from the serene Gulf waters. With a sprawling 5,700 square feet of luxurious living space spread across three levels; this resort style home offers a one-of-a-kind experience for those seeking the ultimate getaway. Accommodations for All: Seven Palms Reunion is the ideal haven for accommodating large groups of up to 36 guests comfortably. Whether you’re planning a memorable family reunion, a girls’ trip, a guys’ weekend, or any combination of family and friends, this opulent property has you covered. Unparalleled Luxury: Throughout the residence, natural wood tones ground the design, adding warmth and texture. From the rich, polished hardwood floors to the carefully chosen furnishings, the infusion of natural wood creates a harmonious balance between the coastal elegance and the warmth of home. The first floor welcomes you with an abundance of natural light, thanks to the large windows that frame the living area. The crisp white shiplap walls and natural wood ceiling with exposed white beams create an ambiance of serenity. Relax by the fireplace amidst neutral furnishings, providing the perfect respite after a day of beachside adventures. The adjacent formal dining area seats 14 and seamlessly flows into the open kitchen. An island with casual seating for five and sleek white cabinets surrounding stainless appliances complete this culinary haven. The kitchen, adorned with textured backsplash tiles, combines form and function. It’s a culinary haven where you can prepare gourmet meals with ease, all while being surrounded by the beauty of the sea-inspired design. The floor to ceiling windows frame the views of the alluring aqua waters of the resort style pool featuring the outdoor haven also includes a summer kitchen, perfect for alfresco dining, and a covered lanai for enjoying the gentle Gulf breezes. Primary Suite Perfection: On the first floor, you’ll find the primary suite, featuring a luxurious four-poster king-size bed and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with a separate soaking tub. It’s a sanctuary of relaxation and comfort. Entertainment Galore: Take the stairs or utilize the convenient elevator to access the second floor, where you’ll discover four more guest bedrooms and an exciting game room. This level boasts a fun game room, a home theater for cinematic experiences, a wet bar for mixing your favorite drinks, and a practical laundry room. Guests will enjoy the comfort of the second and third bedrooms, each offering a suite with king-size beds and private bathrooms. The fourth bedroom includes a king-size bed and a twin-over-twin bunk, accompanied by an attached bathroom. Endless Fun for All: The fifth bedroom is the first of two bunk rooms, featuring four queen-over-queen-size bunk beds, ensuring a cozy and memorable sleepover experience. Top-Floor Oasis: Ascend to the top floor, where you’ll find yet another comfortable living space/game room and a convenient home office. Step outside onto the 25 x 25 Open Air terrace, complete with gulf views and a fireplace for those chilly nights. Sleeping space on this level boasts another bunk room that sleeps 16, with four sets of queen-over-queen-size bunk beds. Luxury Awaits: Seven Palms Reunion offers an unparalleled vacation experience, combining upscale amenities with a prime location in Inlet Beach. Make your reservation today and indulge in the epitome of luxury living on the Gulf Coast. Your unforgettable getaway begins here! Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Master Suite - Private bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Second Floor King Bedroom with Twin/Twin Bunk - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen bunks and One Twin over Twin Bunks - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Third Floor Bunk Room 4 Queen over Queen bunks with Private Bath
